label: Diagram 3.8
caption: Diagram 3.8 Example of a wheelchair accessible kitchen layout
description: Diagram 3.8 is a plan of lettered base units arranged in a U-shape (a three-sided layout opening to the right), the caption reading "Example of a wheelchair accessible kitchen layout". The top run, left to right, is an undimensioned h, shaded cross-marked c, shaded h and shaded g, with segment dimensions 600mm, 800mm and 400mm across c, h and g and an "1800mm total" span covering those three shaded units. The left run is b (hob, four burner circles) and a (sink with tap and drainer grid), with a vertical "2200mm" dimension spanning b and a and the text "Height adjustable or lowerable section of worktop with open leg room below" to its right. The bottom run is h, d, e and cross-marked f, with segment dimensions 600mm, 630mm and 600mm across d, e and f, the bottom-left h being undimensioned. An upper-right inset shows the sink unit set in a corner, with a vertical double-headed "Height adjustable" arrow on its left and the text "Minimum 300mm worktop each side of corner where height adjustable or lowerable section is in a corner" to its right. A heading "Wheelchair accessible layout" sits above the key, which lists a sink and drainer, b hob, c suitable space for built-in oven (c/l 800-900mm), d dishwasher, e washing machine, f fridge freezer, g recycling, h storage base units (inc. corner units). Notes 1 and 2 sit top right, reading "Shaded units represent additional requirements for a wheelchair accessible layout over an equivalent wheelchair adaptable layout" and "Unit length should be measured through mid-line of the worktop, not the front or rear edge"; a footnote reads "Allow for shallow, insulated sink bowl with swivel, mixer tap and flexible plumbing and provide a min. 400mm length of worktop to at least one side of the oven and fridge/freezer", with "*all dimensions are minimum except where noted" at the right.
